defaults.fixtureNote: Every fixture pins the component to the 200px the Figma set draws at (210:2266) and slots the "lei" unit, because `👁️ Suffix` is the one boolean the set leaves true by default. Figma's own numeric-input carries no stepper buttons — the component agrees, `show-steppers` defaults to false — so no fixture sets it.
defaults.pixelNote: Every pixel state lands around 1%: a Figma stroke sits inside the frame while the CSS border adds to it, so the content box is a pixel narrower on each side and the value and the unit sit a pixel in from where Figma draws them. The frame itself matches exactly. The whole bordered-input family (select, text input, this one) is built the same way, so moving the stroke out of the layout is a decision for the family, not for one component.
